testcase.system-out: Scenario: Float and redock the model browser ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the model browser is docked to the left edge of the workspace ✔ When the user drags the model browser by its header into the viewport ✔ Then the model browser becomes a floating panel over the viewport ✔ And the viewport occupies the space previously used by the docked browser ✔ When the user drags the floating browser by its header to the left edge of the workspace ✔ Then the model browser docks at the left edge ✔ And the viewport occupies the remaining workspace
